outputs.explanation: This panel shows a deterministic diagram of exposure time vs. illumination overhead percentage, calculated from fixed camera/instrument timing values rather than averaged experimental replicates. No individual data points are applicable here.

This is a continuous time-course (frame-by-frame) average curve of normalized fluorescence intensity across ~400 frames, shown as mean with shaded s.e.m. Overlaying individual data points at every frame for each of the 5 conditions is impractical and not standard practice for dense kinetic curves; the curve/shading format itself conveys variability.

Panel C plots ΔROS vs. exposure time as a single mean point with error bars for each of the five light-power conditions, based on only three independent experiments per condition. With such a small number of replicates (n=3) and discrete conditions, the individual replicate values could and should have been overlaid on each point, but only the mean±s.e.m. is shown.
Panel D displays raw individual migration tracks for each cell (not an average), so individual data are already fully represented.
The bar graph of migration speed shows the mean±s.e.m. as bars with error bars, and the individual cell data points are overlaid as dots on top of each bar.
Panel F consists of representative micrographs, not a quantitative plot of averaged data.
Panel G is a time-lapse series of representative micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel H is a time-lapse series of representative micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.

Panel I is a continuous time-course line plot of normalized cell area (mean±s.e.m., n=5) across many time points. As with other kinetic curves, individual data points at each time point are not practically overlaid; the mean/error-bar time-series format is the standard convention for this type of data.

Panel J is a continuous time-course line plot of normalized mitochondrial area (mean±s.e.m., n=5) across many time points, analogous to panel I; individual point overlay is impractical for this dense kinetic curve format.
